## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally (typecheck, build, tests) and `pnpm lint` is clean.
- [ ] A changeset was added with `pnpm changeset` (skip only for changes that do not affect the published package).
- [ ] New diagnostic codes, chart types or options are documented in the README and `docs/compatibility.md`.
- [ ] Any claim about Microsoft Excel was verified in Excel, or is worded as "LibreOffice render" / "structural validation" (see `docs/manual-qa.md`).
